info.title: Casino platform — player API (gateway)
info.description: Every player-facing route the gateway forwards, from identity (under /api/id), core, payments and bonus. Auth travels in httpOnly cookies by default; send `X-Auth-Transport: bearer` to receive tokens in the body instead. Edge errors are RFC 7807 problems with errorCode UNKNOWN_HOST, COUNTRY_BLOCKED (451), SKIN_MISMATCH (403), RATE_LIMITED (429) or UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE (502).

post.summary: Disconnect Telegram. 409 LAST_SIGN_IN_METHOD when it is the only way in: set a password first.
The link sent to a pending new email: anonymous like verify-email, because it may be opened on another device.

get.description: Google's return leg. The gateway sets the session cookies and redirects to the skin's callback URL with `#login=ok&expires_at=…&SessionId=…` — no token reaches the page. Navigate here from the url `GET /api/id/auth/google` answers.

200.description: Session established; tokens are in httpOnly cookies (or in the body with X-Auth-Transport: bearer).

get.summary: The signed-in player's contacts, pending changes, sign-in methods and consent.

post.summary: Add or change the email: a confirmation link goes to the NEW address; the current one stays until it is followed.
Add or change the phone: an SMS code goes to the NEW number; the current one stays until it is confirmed.
The SMS code sent to the pending number; the number becomes the account's.
"Resend confirmation" for the pending email or phone change (contact = email | phone).

delete.summary: "Cancel change": drops the pending email or phone and its link/code.

post.summary: A FIRST password, for an account that signs in only through Telegram or Google. 409 if it has one — use change-password.
Records the legal-age consent for an account created by a social sign-in (the register form asks it for the rest).

post.description: Clears the session cookies whatever the upstream answers. Needs the session's credential (cookie or bearer) like any authenticated call; the edge itself lets an EXPIRED access token through so a stale browser session can still be ended.

post.summary: Open a game: demo or real, optionally bonus-funded. Answers the provider's HTML fragment.

get.summary: The skin's catalogue: search (name, provider, keywords), category and provider codes, badge hot|new, sort popular|newest|name|provider, paged.
One game the skin shows; 404 for a game it does not (hidden, inactive, or another skin's).
The categories the skin shows, in the skin's order, each with its visible game count.
Providers with at least one game on the skin, curated order first, each with its count.
Active banners inside their display window; ?placement= narrows to one preset key (home-hero).
Active promotions inside their window, in the skin's order, texts in the request's language.
One live promotion with its full terms; 404 when inactive, out of window or unknown.
The player's favourite games on this skin, newest first.

put.summary: ♥ a game the skin shows. Idempotent; 404 for a game the skin does not show; 409 past the favourites ceiling.

delete.summary: Un-♥ a game. Idempotent: removing what is not there is still 204.

get.summary: The player's profile on this skin. The player number is assigned on the first read.

put.summary: Set the display name and city (null or empty clears one). 400 names the rule a value broke.

get.summary: Deposit methods this skin offers, newest configuration first. Optional currency filter.
Withdrawal methods this skin offers. A method may take deposits without paying out, and vice versa.

post.summary: Start a deposit: returns where to pay. The money arrives when the provider calls back, not here.

get.summary: The player's own payment history, newest first. type = deposit | withdrawal | (both).

post.summary: What this withdrawal would cost and forfeit, and whether the rules allow it. Writes nothing. forfeitNotice is always present and must be shown: the forfeit takes whatever bonus is active when the withdrawal is paid.

Request a withdrawal: the amount is held out of the balance and an operator decides. Refused with CONFLICT when an active bonus would be forfeited and acknowledgeBonusForfeit is not set. The bonus is forfeited only when the withdrawal is approved and paid, never on the request.

get.summary: Open definitions of the skin, with the caller's pending activation / current step when authenticated.

post.summary: Opt in by id or promo code; a repeated opt-in answers the existing activation.

get.summary: Pending (unconsumed) opt-ins.

post.summary: Withdraw a pending opt-in (a consumed one cannot be cancelled here — cancel the instance instead).

get.summary: The player's instances (all statuses) plus pending opt-ins as zero rows — the old GetActivePlayerBonuses.
Does an active bonus apply to this game? Drives the skin's 'play with your bonus balance?' prompt.

post.summary: Give up the active bonus: bonus + locked are forfeited through wallet. Idempotent.

get.summary: Free rounds the player holds, any status.
Free-rounds campaigns the player can claim now — in window, with games, uses left (P3-29).

post.summary: Claim a free-rounds campaign; the rounds are assigned at the provider through core before the holding exists.

get.summary: Open the panel: my conversation on this skin (null before my first message) and its latest messages, oldest first.
Older history: the messages before `before` (a message id), oldest first.

post.summary: Write to support: `text`, or tap a canned question (`cannedAnswerId` — the answer comes back as a system line). The same `clientMessageId` sent twice lands once and answers the same lines. Rate-limited per conversation (429).
I've seen everything support wrote — my unread count goes to zero.

get.summary: The questions I can tap for an instant answer, for this skin (and `language`, e.g. en), in display order.
